topic: Break-even point ko simple tiffin example se samajhna
caption:
Monthly fixed kharcha ₹15,000 hai aur har tiffin se ₹30 contribution bachta hai. Break-even ke liye kitne tiffin chahiye? 👇

₹15,000 ÷ ₹30 = 500 tiffins. Is simple example mein 500 orders fixed kharcha cover karte hain; uske baad contribution aage ke kharche/profit mein jaata hai. Agar cost ya contribution badle, calculation bhi update karo.

Apne business ka monthly fixed kharcha aur per-order contribution likh kar break-even nikalo.

#BusinessJalwa #BreakEvenPoint #SmallBusiness #BusinessBasics #Hinglish

scenes.narration: Mahine ka fixed kharcha pandrah hazaar rupaye hai. Har tiffin bechne ke baad tees rupaye contribution bachta hai. Break-even ke liye kitne tiffin bechne honge?
scenes.question: Fixed cost ₹15,000

scenes.narration: Pehle samjho: contribution matlab selling price mein se har order ki variable cost nikalne ke baad bachi rakam. Pichhle example mein sau mein se sattar ghata kar tees rupaye bache the.
scenes.question: Per tiffin bache

scenes.narration: Ab monthly fixed cost ko per tiffin contribution se divide karo. Pandrah hazaar divide tees barabar paanch sau tiffin.
Is simple hisaab mein paanch sau tiffin par contribution fixed kharcha cover karta hai. Yahan break-even par profit zero hota hai; extra costs hon to unhe bhi jodo.
scenes.question: 500 par kya?

scenes.narration: Agar mahine mein pachchees din kaam karte ho, to paanch sau orders ka matlab roz bees tiffin. Apni actual cost daal kar target set karo.
scenes.question: 500 ÷ 25 din
